name: Union-Size Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit edge-by-edge construction of a triangle with a set-theoretic property: three edges (files) whose union of vertices (workers) has a size of exactly 3. Models that pattern-match will literally translate this into an O(m^3) file-combination loop and TLE, while models that reason mathematically will deduce it describes a triangle and use the O(n*m/64) adjacency bitset algorithm.
